title: Single-file LRU cache with Map-based recency
description: Implement a Least-Recently-Used cache with O(1) get and put using a Map for insertion-order recency tracking.

title: Single-file debounced Promise queue (serial executor)
description: Run async tasks one at a time in FIFO order, guaranteeing no overlap with a promise-chain tail.

title: Single-file throttle with trailing call
description: Limit a function to at most once per interval while guaranteeing the last call still runs after the interval.

title: Single-file Trie for word autocomplete
description: Build a prefix tree supporting insert, search, startsWith, and collect-all-words-with-prefix for autocomplete.

title: Single-file min-heap (binary heap) priority queue
description: Implement a binary min-heap with push, pop (smallest), peek and size, used for priority scheduling.

title: Single-file topological sort (Kahn's algorithm)
description: Return a topologically ordered list of nodes from a dependency graph using in-degree counting, or a cycle error.

title: Single-file merge interval merger
description: Merge overlapping numeric intervals like [[1,3],[2,6],[8,10]] into non-overlapping spans.

title: Single-file dead simple rate limiter (token bucket)
description: A token-bucket limiter that allows burst capacity and refills at a fixed rate, returning allow timestamped tokens.

title: Single-file circular buffer (ring buffer)
description: Fixed-capacity ring buffer with push, shift, and overwrite-oldest behavior for streaming windows.

title: Single-file djb2 + FNV-1a string hash utilities
description: Two classic non-cryptographic string hash functions returning 32-bit unsigned integers.

title: Single-file URL query string parser and serializer
description: Parse a query string into an object (handling arrays and booleans) and serialize an object back into a query string.

title: Single-file polite natural-language number to words
description: Convert integers up to billions into English words, e.g. 1234 => one thousand two hundred thirty-four.

title: Single-file cron-like time-of-day scheduler (24h)
description: A tiny scheduler with setTime(action, 'HH:MM') callbacks and 1-second ticker that fires when wall time matches.

title: Single-file map/object path getter and setter
description: Get and set nested values by dot path like 'a.b[2].c', creating missing intermediate objects.

title: Single-file simple pub/sub event bus
description: A tiny publish-subscribe bus with on/off/emit and wildcard topic support.

title: Single-file zero-dependency UUID v4 generator
description: Generate RFC-4122 version-4 UUIDs from crypto.getRandomValues without any dependency.

title: Single-file DOM el helper (hyperscript-style)
description: A compact h(tag, props, children) helper to build DOM nodes programmatically with event and attribute support.

title: Single-file simple state store with subscribe (external store pattern)
description: A minimal external store: getState/setState/subscribe with immutable updates and snapshot separation.

title: Single-file callback-free promise timeout wrapper
description: Wrap any promise with a timeout that rejects if it does not settle in ms, or awaits an abort out.

title: Single-file Fisher-Yates shuffle (in place)
description: Uniformly shuffle an array in place using the Fisher-Yates algorithm and an optional RNG.

title: Single-file simple object diff
description: Return the set of changed/added/removed keys between two flat objects with deep-compare on equal.

title: Single-file natural mergesort (bottom-up)
description: Stable bottom-up mergesort over arrays with a comparator, using an aux buffer to merge runs.

title: Single-file sliding window max
description: Given an array and window size, return the max of each contiguous window using a monotonic deque (O(n)).

title: Single-file longest common prefix of strings
description: Return the longest common prefix across an array of strings, or an empty string if none share a prefix.

title: Single-file parse human size strings to/from bytes
description: Convert '1.5 MB', '300KB', '2GB' to bytes and bytes to a compact human-readable string.

title: Single-file retainEventLoop-safe sleep with abort
description: Sleep ms that resolves early via an AbortSignal and never leaks timers.

title: Single-file count words with frequency map and ordering
description: Count word frequencies in a string, normalizing case, and return an array sorted by count descending.

title: Single-file light template engine (mustache-lite)
description: Render a tiny template with {{var}} interpolation and {{#each list}}...{{/each}} loops from a context object.

title: Single-file wildcard glob matcher
description: Match a string against a pattern with * (any) and ? (single char) wildcards using dynamic programming.

title: Single-file JSON pretty print with indentation
description: Serialize any JSON-safe value into an indented, readable string with custom indent width.

title: Single-file rolling average / EMA stream stats
description: Maintain a running exponential moving average and simple windowed average over streaming values.

title: Single-file Pascal/Param/camel/snake case converter
description: Convert any input to camelCase, snake_case, kebab-case, PascalCase, or CONSTANT_CASE via one tokenizer.

title: Single-file two-pointer subsequence check
description: Return true if s is a subsequence of t (characters in order) using a single two-pointer scan.

title: Single-file pixelate data-URI uppercase base64 checksum
description: Compute a stable FNV-style checksum over a string and render it as a short uppercase hex tag for fingerprinting.

title: Single-file priority-based event loop microtask debounce
description: Batch synchronous writes into a single microtask flush with a clean copy of the buffer each cycle.

title: Single-file run-length encoding / decoding
description: Compress runs of repeated characters like aaabbc => a3b2c1 and decode back, handling digits in input.

title: Single-file circular depend check between modules
description: Detect whether an import graph (map of module -> deps) contains a cycle using colored DFS.

title: Single-file HTML entity escape helper
description: Escape user input for safe insertion into HTML and reverse-escape back to raw text.

title: Single-file chunk array into fixed-size groups
description: Split an array into an array of chunks of the given size, keeping the remainder as the last chunk.
